summary: Write each block A_U − A♭_U as the sum over terms of the integrals of β_cβ_c'(K − K^cut), bound it by the cut error of amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le (ν·b^{−k³f}/2 for fixed c, s), sum the squares over at most #Classes·#𝖦 blocks and compare with b⁻³⁰𝖽₁ using #𝖦 ≤ g^{r²f} ≤ b^{23r²f} and k large.

steps.claim: Unfold energy and amplitudeSum: the block (c, s, c') of A_U − A♭_U is the difference of two summable sums over the terms of U over (c, s, c'), hence the sum of the differences of amplitudes; the sum over s is moved outside and norms are written through extended norms. The goal becomes Σ_c Σ_{s∈Ω} Σ_{c'} ‖Σ_γ (amplitude − amplitude^cut)‖² / ν² ≤ b⁻³⁰𝖽₁.
steps.lean:
simp [energy, amplitudeSum, summable_amplitude, ← Summable.tsum_sub, ← Finset.sum_div,
    @sum_comm S.GRes, ← toReal_enorm]

steps.claim: Record the size facts used below: k = 1000(2ϱ+2) + r' for some r' (from 1000(2ϱ+2) ≤ k), 1 ≤ b, k ≤ f, and ν > 0.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨r, k⟩⟩ := S.ϱ_le_k.dest, S.one_le_b, S.k_le_f, S.unipCovolume_pos

steps.claim: Main bound. Unfold 𝖽₁ = |S̄|·#Classes·#BesselCoord and drop the factors |S̄| ≥ 1 and #BesselCoord ≥ 1 on the right; enlarge the sum over s ∈ Ω to all s ∈ 𝖦; use Σ_{c'} x_{c'}² ≤ (Σ_{c'} x_{c'})² for nonnegative x; bound each block norm by the corresponding sum of integrals (a side goal, steps 7–8); and bound Σ_{c'} Σ_γ ∫ β_c(y)β_c'(γ_∞⁻¹y)‖K(γ,y) − K^cut(γ,y)‖ dy ≤ ν·b^{−k³f}/2 by amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le. The goal becomes #Classes·#𝖦·(ν b^{−k³f}/2)²/ν² ≤ b⁻³⁰·#Classes.
steps.lean:
grw [besselEnergy, columnDim, ← le_mul_of_one_le_right' NeZero.one_le, filter_subset,
    sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg, ← Nat.card_pos.succ_le, (toReal_sum _).ge,
    toReal_le_of_le_ofReal _ ∘ (amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le U ..).2.trans']

steps.claim: Simplification of the resulting real inequality (ν > 0 cancels) and of the nonnegativity side conditions.
Each residue field at a chosen place above q_i has q_i elements and there are f chosen places above each q_i, so #𝖦 ≤ (q₀q₁)^{r²f} = g^{r²f}.

With g ≤ b²³ and 2 ≥ 1, the inequality reduces to one between powers of b, b^{23r²f}·b^{−2k³f}/4 ≤ b^{−30}; comparing exponents with k = 1000(2ϱ+2) + r' (step 2), r = 2ϱ + k + 1 and k ≤ f, it holds (linear arithmetic).
steps.lean: grw [g_le_b_pow, ← one_le_two]; simp [← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← k]; gcongr; lia

steps.claim: Side goal of step 3: the difference of the amplitudes for W and for W^cut equals the integral of (β_cβ_c')·(K − K^cut) (both integrands are integrable, since their absolute integrals are finite by the first part of amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le).
steps.lean:
simp [amplitude, ← integral_sub, ← smul_sub, -toReal_mul, fun [Side] c s d γ ↦
    integrable_toReal_smul (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    ((ENNReal.le_tsum γ).trans_lt ((amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le U c s).1 d).2)]

steps.claim: Hence ‖Σ_γ ∫ β_cβ_c'(K − K^cut)‖ ≤ Σ_γ ∫ β_cβ_c'‖K − K^cut‖ (norm of a sum, norm of an integral, |t·x| ≤ t‖x‖).
